model: Twenty-fourth Hellfire Firefighting Battalion; 84th Avalon LI; 17th Avalon Hussars

fluff.overview: The AFFS dedicates significant resources to non-combat infantry specialties, recognizing that war produces destruction that must be managed alongside the fighting itself. The Hellfire Battalions are among the most unusual formations in any Successor State military: motorized firefighting engineers equipped to suppress battlefield blazes and protect civilian infrastructure during planetary assaults. Riding compact all-purpose vehicles, Hellfire troops are more likely to be seen carrying shovels and portable chemical sprayers than their issued Thunderstroke II gauss rifles. The guns were selected for their inability to start fires rather than for raw stopping power, a practical choice that reflects the formation's unusual dual mission of fire suppression and area security.
